tasks.prompt: Deep dive on Village Farms International (VFF) at $2.50. Cannabis and produce company. tasks.prompt: MOAT ANALYSIS: Village Farms (VFF). They operate large-scale greenhouse facilities in Texas and British Columbia. Pure Sunfarms is their cannabis brand in Canada. They also grow tomatoes, peppers, and cucumbers. What is the competitive advantage of their greenhouse infrastructure? Can they convert greenhouse capacity between produce and cannabis? Is this a structural advantage? Who competes with them in greenhouse cannabis? What is their cost-per-gram vs peers?

tasks.prompt: US CANNABIS MARKET ENTRY: Village Farms (VFF) has massive greenhouse infrastructure in Texas. If US federal legalization happens, can they convert Texas greenhouses to cannabis? What is the realistic timeline for US legalization? SAFE Banking Act status? What states are most likely to benefit? Does VFF have any US cannabis operations currently? How does their position compare to MSOs (multi-state operators) like CURA, GTII, TRUL?

tasks.prompt: FINANCIAL FORENSIC: Village Farms (VFF). Live data: Revenue $226M (+26.6%), NI $25.9M, FCF $13.8M, P/E 11.4x. But the insider (Bovenschen) SOLD 50K shares at $2.89 in March 2026.
